# Mohamed Yaakoubi - AI Language Technology Specialist & Portfolio

> Portfolio, software engineering work, and AI innovations of Mohamed Yaakoubi.

## Overview
Mohamed Yaakoubi is an AI Language Technology Specialist, Full-Stack Developer, and Founder based in Sousse, Tunisia. He specializes in natural language processing (NLP), Arabic dialectal computing, agentic workflows, and high-performance web applications built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Primary Projects
- **SheetDiff™** (https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/sheetdiff): A Google Sheets add-on and high-precision tabular data comparison engine. Features cell-level diffing, fuzzy matching, and REST API integration.
- **Potential** (https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/projects/potential): Human potential and career exploration platform.
- **DocuMed** (https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/projects/documed): Medical documentation and patient record management system.
- **InternationalSkills** (https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/projects/internationalskills): Global competency assessment and talent discovery engine.
